en.t: Edward III crowned at Westminster Abbey
en.s: On 1 February 1327, fourteen-year-old Edward III was crowned king of England at Westminster Abbey in London, in present-day United Kingdom.

zh.t: 爱德华三世在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕
zh.s: 1327年2月1日，14岁的爱德华三世在伦敦威斯敏斯特教堂加冕为英格兰国王。伦敦位于今英国境内。

en.s: The Teutonic Order conducted a siege of Medvėgalis, a Lithuanian fortress in Samogitia, in February 1329. The 18,000-strong Teutonic army — reinforced by many guest crusaders, including King John of Bohemia — captured four Lithuanian fortresses and besieged Medvėgalis. The fortress surrendered, and as many as 6,000 locals were baptized in the Catholic rite.

zh.s: 1329年2月，条顿骑士团围攻萨莫吉希亚的立陶宛堡垒梅德韦加利斯。条顿军队有1.8万人，并得到包括波希米亚国王约翰在内的多名外来十字军增援；他们攻占了4座立陶宛堡垒，随后围困梅德韦加利斯。堡垒最终投降，当地最多有6000人接受了天主教洗礼。

Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth forces under the command of Mikołaj Korff and Konstanty Zienowicz defeated the Swedish forces commanded by Gustav Horn.

en.s: The Battle of Cremona was a battle of the War of the Spanish Succession that took place on 1 February 1702 between France and Austria. Five months after repulsing the French at the Battle of Chieri (Chiari) in Lombardy, Prince Eugene of Savoy retook the offensive, moving westward with the Austrian army of Leopold I, Holy Roman Emperor to Cremona on the Po. On 1 February 1702, Eugene conducted a night attack that caught the French garrison, under Marshal François de Neufville, Duc de Velleroi, completely by surprise.

zh.s: 1702年2月1日，西班牙王位继承战争期间，法国与奥地利在克雷莫纳交战。五个月前，萨伏依的欧根亲王曾在伦巴第的基亚里战役中击退法军；随后他再次转入进攻，率神圣罗马皇帝利奥波德一世的奥地利军队西进至波河畔的克雷莫纳。2月1日，欧根发起夜袭，使维勒鲁瓦公爵弗朗索瓦·德·讷夫维尔元帅率领的法国驻军措手不及。

zh.t: 奥斯曼军队在本德尔俘虏查理十二世
zh.s: 旧历1713年2月1日，奥斯曼军队进攻瑞典国王查理十二世在本德尔的营地，在数小时抵抗后将他俘虏。本德尔位于今摩尔多瓦境内。
zh.n: 2月1日为旧历，对应公历1713年2月12日。战斗发生在本德尔，并非俄罗斯。

en.s: The Java War of 1741 to 1743 was an armed struggle by a joint Chinese and Javanese army against the Dutch East India Company and pro-Dutch Javanese that took place in central and eastern Java. Ending in victory for the Dutch, the war led to the fall of the Sultanate of Mataram and, indirectly, the founding of both the Sunanate of Surakarta and the Sultanate of Yogyakarta. Following years of growing anti-Chinese sentiment, Dutch forces massacred 10,000 ethnic Chinese in Batavia (now Jakarta) in October 1740. A group of survivors led by Khe Pandjang fled east for Semarang. Despite being warned of the impending uprising, the head of the Dutch East India Company's military, Bartholomeus Visscher, ignored his advisers and did not prepare reinforcements. As the situation developed, the court of Pakubuwono II, Sunan of Mataram, decided to tentatively support the Chinese while seemingly helping the Dutch. After the first casualties on 1 February 1741 in Pati, Chinese insurgents spread through central Java, joining forces with the Javanese while staging sham battles to convince the Dutch that the Javanese were supporting them.

zh.s: 1741年至1743年的爪哇战争，是由华人和爪哇人组成的联军与荷兰东印度公司及亲荷兰的爪哇人之间的武装冲突，战事发生在爪哇岛中部和东部。战争以荷兰获胜告终，导致马打蓝苏丹国覆灭，并间接促成苏拉卡尔塔苏苏侯国和日惹苏丹国的建立。1740年10月，在反华情绪多年加剧后，荷兰军队在巴达维亚（今雅加达）屠杀了1万名华人。一批幸存者在克潘让带领下向东逃往三宝垄。尽管有人警告起义即将爆发，荷兰东印度公司军队负责人巴尔托洛梅乌斯·维舍尔仍无视顾问意见，没有准备增援。局势发展期间，马打蓝苏丹苏苏胡南二世的宫廷决定暂时支持华人，同时表面上帮助荷兰人。1741年2月1日，帕蒂出现首批伤亡后，华人起义者扩展到爪哇中部，与爪哇人联手，并安排假战斗，让荷兰人误以为爪哇人站在他们一边。

en.s: The siege of Stirling Castle took place from 8 January to 1 February 1746, during the 1745 Rising, when a Jacobite force besieged Stirling Castle, held by a government garrison under William Blakeney. Despite defeating a relief force under Henry Hawley at Falkirk Muir on 17 January, the siege made little progress; when Cumberland's army began advancing north from Edinburgh, it was abandoned and on 1 February the Jacobites withdrew to Inverness.

en.s: The Battle of Cowan's Ford was a battle in the Southern Theater of Cornwallis's 1780–1782 Campaign that eventually led to the British Army's surrender at Yorktown during the American Revolutionary War. It was fought on 1 February 1781 at Cowan's ford on the Catawba River in northwestern Mecklenburg County, North Carolina, between a force of about 5,000 British and fewer than a thousand Americans who were attempting to slow the British advance across the river. The American general William Lee Davidson was killed in this battle.

zh.s: 考恩渡口战役是美国独立战争南部战场、康沃利斯1780—1782年战役行动的一部分，这场系列战事最终以英军在约克镇投降告终。1781年2月1日，约5000名英军在北卡罗来纳州梅克伦堡县西北部的卡托巴河考恩渡口，与不足1000名试图阻止英军渡河的美军交战。美军将领威廉·李·戴维森在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The 1783 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on February 1, 1783. The former delegate to the Congress of the Confederation from Delaware Nicholas Van Dyke was elected president of Delaware for a term of three years. The previous president John Dickinson resigned on November 4, 1782, following his election as president of Pennsylvania. The president of the Council John Cook acted as president pending the election of Dickinson's successor.

zh.s: 特拉华州于1783年2月1日举行州长选举，前邦联国会特拉华州代表尼古拉斯·范戴克当选，当时职衔为州主席，任期三年。前任约翰·迪金森当选宾夕法尼亚州主席后，于1782年11月4日辞职。在选出继任者之前，由州参议机构议长约翰·库克代理州主席。

en.s: The Battle of La Rothière was fought on 1 February 1814 between the French Empire and allied army of Austria, Prussia, Russia, and German States previously allies with France. The French were led by Emperor Napoleon and the coalition army was under the command of Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher. Attacked by a large force in severe weather conditions (wet snowstorm), the French managed to hold until they could retreat under cover of darkness. Multinational coalition forces used white shoulder bands to distinguish friends from foes during the battle.

zh.s: 1814年2月1日，法兰西帝国军队与奥地利、普鲁士、俄罗斯及此前同法国结盟的德意志各邦组成的联军，在拉罗蒂埃交战。法军由拿破仑皇帝率领，联军由格布哈德·莱贝雷希特·冯·布吕歇尔指挥。法军在夹杂湿雪的恶劣暴风雪中遭优势兵力进攻，仍坚持到入夜，随后借夜色撤退。战斗中，多国联军佩戴白色肩带，以辨别敌我。

en.s: The Battle of Cepeda of 1820 took place on February 1 in Cañada de Cepeda, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina. The conflict was the first major battle that saw Unitarians and Federals as two constituted sides. It ended with the defeat of the national government. Federal League Provinces of Santa Fe, Entre Ríos and José Miguel Carrera joined forces to topple the 1819 centralist Constitution and the Directorial government of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata.

zh.s: 1820年塞佩达战役于2月1日在阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯省的塞佩达峡谷打响。这是统一派和联邦派作为两支明确阵营交战的首场重大战役，以中央政府战败告终。圣菲、恩特雷里奥斯等联邦同盟省份与何塞·米格尔·卡雷拉联手，推翻1819年中央集权宪法以及拉普拉塔联合省的督政府。

en.s: The Paraguay Expedition was a United States Naval mission sent to Asunción, Paraguay, in 1858 to demand indemnity and apology from the Paraguayan Government for the 1 February 1855 firing on the U.S. Navy vessel USS Water Witch and for alleged insults against the United States and Paraguay Navigation Company. This was an example of U.S. gunboat diplomacy. Carlos Antonio López agreed to indemnify the families of the crew and the Supreme Court of the United States declared the innocence of the Paraguayan Government in the incidents.

zh.s: 1858年，美国派海军前往巴拉圭亚松森，要求巴拉圭政府为1855年2月1日向美军“水巫”号舰艇开炮，以及据称侮辱美国—巴拉圭航运公司的行为，作出赔偿并道歉。这是美国炮舰外交的一个例子。卡洛斯·安东尼奥·洛佩斯同意赔偿船员家属，而美国最高法院则裁定巴拉圭政府在相关事件中无罪。

en.t: Texas in the American Civil War
en.s: The American state of Texas declared its secession from the Union on February 1, 1861, and joined the Confederate States on March 2, 1861, after it had replaced its governor, Sam Houston, who had refused to take an oath of allegiance to the Confederacy. Houston had tried to forestall any steps the state might take towards secession but the State Legislature threw its support behind a secession convention, whose decision was approved by a statewide plebiscite overwhelmingly.

zh.t: 美国内战期间的得克萨斯州
zh.s: 美国得克萨斯州于1861年2月1日宣布脱离联邦，并于同年3月2日加入美利坚联盟国。此前，得州更换了州长山姆·休斯敦；他拒绝向联盟国宣誓效忠。休斯敦曾试图阻止州政府采取脱离联邦的行动，但州议会支持召开脱离联邦会议，其决定随后在全州公投中以压倒性多数获批。

en.s: The Second Schleswig War or German-Danish War, also sometimes known as the Dano-Prussian War or Prusso-Danish War, was the second military conflict over the Schleswig–Holstein question of the 19th century. The war began on 1 February 1864, when Prussian and Austrian forces crossed the border into the Danish fief Schleswig. Denmark fought troops of the Kingdom of Prussia and the Austrian Empire representing the German Confederation.

zh.t: 第二次石勒苏益格战争
zh.s: 第二次石勒苏益格战争又称德丹战争，也有丹麦—普鲁士战争或普鲁士—丹麦战争之称，是19世纪围绕石勒苏益格—荷尔斯泰因问题爆发的第二场军事冲突。战争于1864年2月1日爆发，普鲁士和奥地利军队越境进入丹麦属地石勒苏益格。丹麦与代表德意志邦联的普鲁士王国和奥地利帝国军队交战。

en.t: Thirteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution
en.s: The Thirteenth Amendment (Amendment XIII) to the United States Constitution made slavery and involuntary servitude illegal, except as punishment for a crime. The amendment was passed by the Senate on April 8, 1864, by the House of Representatives on January 31, 1865, and ratified by the required 27 of the then 36 states on December 6, 1865, and proclaimed on December 18, 1865.
en.n: President Abraham Lincoln signs the Thirteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution.

en.t: Fountains Valley, Pretoria, the oldest nature reserve in Africa, is proclaimed by President Paul Kruger
en.s: The Fountains Valley is a recreational resort at the southern entrance to Pretoria in South Africa. It was proclaimed as a nature reserve by President Paul Kruger on 1 February 1895. Consequently, this 60 ha reserve, along with the contiguous Groenkloof Nature Reserve, constitute the oldest nature reserves on the African continent. The Apies River flows through the resort, and the area has two natural water sources.

zh.s: 1896年2月1日，普契尼的歌剧《波希米亚人》在意大利都灵皇家剧院举行世界首演，由阿尔图罗·托斯卡尼尼指挥。

en.s: The Santo Domingo Affair, or the Santo Domingo Crisis, refers to an incident from 1 February 1904 to 11 February 1904 involving the United States and Dominican militia forces in the Dominican Republic. After the death of a seaman from the USS Yankee on February 1, the U.S. military launched a punitive expedition which routed the Dominican forces.

en.s: The Khotyn Uprising (Romanian: Răscoala de la Hotin or Revolta de la Hotin; Ukrainian: Хотинське повстання, romanized: Khotyns'ke povstannya) was a Ukrainian-led insurrection in the far-northern tip of the Bessarabia region, nestled between Bukovina and Podolia. It occurred on January 7–February 1, 1919, less than a year after Bessarabia's integration into the Romanian Kingdom.

en.s: The 1937 South American Championship play-off was a match held to determine the winner of the 1937 South American Championship, the 14th edition of this continental championship, as Argentina and Brazil were tied for the first place after the regular competition. The match took place on February 1, 1937, at Estadio Gasómetro in Buenos Aires. Argentina won the match 2–0, winning its fifth continental title.

zh.t: 1937年南美足球锦标赛冠军附加赛
zh.s: 第14届南美足球锦标赛常规比赛结束后，阿根廷与巴西并列第一，因此加赛决定1937年冠军归属。附加赛于1937年2月1日在布宜诺斯艾利斯加索梅特罗球场举行。阿根廷以2比0获胜，第五次夺得洲际冠军。

en.s: The Marshalls–Gilberts raids were tactical airstrikes and naval artillery attacks by United States Navy aircraft carrier and other warship forces against Imperial Japanese Navy (IJN) garrisons in the Marshall and Gilbert Islands on 1 February 1942. The Japanese garrisons were under the overall command of Vice Admiral Shigeyoshi Inoue, commander of the 4th Fleet. Japanese aircraft in the islands belonged to the IJN's 24th Air Flotilla under Rear Admiral Eiji Gotō.

zh.t: 马绍尔—吉尔伯特群岛突袭
zh.s: 1942年2月1日，美国海军航空母舰及其他军舰对马绍尔群岛和吉尔伯特群岛的日本海军驻军发动战术空袭和舰炮攻击。日军驻军由第四舰队司令井上成美海军中将统一指挥，岛上的日本飞机则隶属后藤英次海军少将指挥的第24航空战队。

en.t: Voice of America begins German-language broadcasts
en.s: On February 1, 1942, the American broadcasting service that became Voice of America transmitted a German-language programme to Germany under the name Stimmen aus Amerika. The broadcast promised to report the news truthfully, whether good or bad for the United States.

zh.t: 美国之音开始对德语广播
zh.s: 1942年2月1日，后来成为美国之音的美国广播服务以“来自美国的声音”为名，向德国播出德语节目。节目承诺，无论消息对美国有利还是不利，都会如实报道。

en.s: In the final years of the British Mandate for Palestine (1944–48), tensions between the British authorities and the Zionist movement escalated into an armed insurgency. Zionist militias and underground groups—including Haganah, Lehi, and Irgun—carried out a paramilitary campaign against British rule in Mandatory Palestine. The tensions between the Zionist underground and the British mandatory authorities rose from 1938 and intensified with the publication of the White Paper of 1939.

zh.t: 巴勒斯坦托管地的犹太人起义
zh.s: 英国对巴勒斯坦的托管统治进入最后几年（1944—1948年）时，英国当局与犹太复国主义运动之间的紧张关系升级为武装起义。哈加纳、莱希和伊尔贡等犹太复国主义民兵及地下组织在巴勒斯坦托管地开展了准军事行动，反抗英国统治。犹太地下组织与英国托管当局的紧张关系从1938年起不断加剧，并在1939年《白皮书》发布后进一步升高。

en.s: The Battle of the Twin Tunnels (French: Bataille de Twin-Tunnels) took place during the Korean War. In which the UN forces inflicted heavy casualties on the People's Volunteer Army (PVA). The "Twin Tunnels" refer to a series of railroad tunnels along the Central Line in eastern Jije-myeon, Yangpyeong County, Gyeonggi Province, South Korea.

en.s: Northeast Airlines Flight 823 was a scheduled flight in the United States, from New York City's LaGuardia Airport to Miami International Airport, Florida, which crashed shortly after takeoff on February 1, 1957. The aircraft operating the service was a Douglas DC-6 four-engined propeller airliner, registration N34954, which entered service in 1955. It crashed near Rikers Island, which sent corrections personnel and inmates to rescue and assist survivors.

zh.s: 东北航空823号班机是从美国纽约市拉瓜迪亚机场飞往佛罗里达州迈阿密国际机场的定期航班，于1957年2月1日起飞后不久坠毁。执行航班的是一架道格拉斯DC-6四发螺旋桨客机，注册号N34954，于1955年投入使用。飞机坠毁于赖克斯岛附近，岛上的监狱工作人员和囚犯参与了救援，帮助幸存者。

en.s: General elections were held in Costa Rica on February 1, 1970. José Figueres Ferrer of the National Liberation Party won the presidential election, whilst his party also won the parliamentary election. Voter turnout was 83.3%. On June 25, 1969 the Legislative Assembly of Costa Rica reform the Constitution outlawing presidential reelection, but as any legal reform is retroactive, all previous presidents could be candidates one more time. Two former presidents José Figueres Ferrer and Mario Echandi Jiménez were the two main candidates in the election. Echandi was nominated by then ruling party National Unification, a right-wing conservative party made out of the merge of the Republicans (Calderonistas) and the National Union (Ulatistas).

zh.s: 哥斯达黎加于1970年2月1日举行大选。民族解放党的何塞·菲格雷斯·费雷尔赢得总统选举，该党也赢得议会选举，投票率为83.3%。1969年6月25日，立法大会修宪禁止总统再次当选；既有总统仍可再参选一次。两名前总统菲格雷斯·费雷尔和马里奥·埃昌迪·希门尼斯成为本次选举的主要候选人。埃昌迪由当时执政的民族统一党提名；该党是右翼保守政党，由卡尔德隆派共和党与乌拉特派民族联盟合并而成。原文关于修宪是否具有追溯力的表述，与其对前总统参选资格的说明存在矛盾。

en.s: The 1972 Louisiana gubernatorial election was held on February 1, 1972. Edwin Edwards defeated Republican candidate David Treen to become Governor of Louisiana. Edwards's victory was the first time a Roman Catholic had been elected to the state's governorship since Francis T. Nicholls left office in 1892. Party primaries were held on November 6, 1971, and a run-off was held for the Democratic nomination on December 18, 1971.

zh.s: 路易斯安那州于1972年2月1日举行州长选举。埃德温·爱德华兹击败共和党候选人戴维·特林，当选州长。这是自弗朗西斯·T.尼科尔斯于1892年卸任以来，首次有罗马天主教徒当选该州州长。各党初选于1971年11月6日举行，民主党提名的第二轮投票则于12月18日举行。

en.s: The 1972 Louisiana lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on February 1, 1972, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Louisiana. Democratic nominee Jimmy Fitzmorris defeated Republican nominee Morley A. Hudson and American nominee Gertrude Taylor.

en.s: Edifício Praça da Bandeira, formerly known as the Joelma Building, is a 25-story building in downtown São Paulo, Brazil, completed in 1971, located at Avenida 9 de Julho, 225. On 1 February 1974, an air conditioning unit on the twelfth floor overheated, starting a fire. Because flammable materials had been used to furnish the interior, the entire building was engulfed in flames within twenty minutes.

zh.s: 巴西圣保罗市中心的班德拉广场大厦（Edifício Praça da Bandeira）于1971年建成，曾名若尔马大厦，楼高25层，地址是九月九日大道225号。1974年2月1日，12楼的一台空调过热起火。由于室内装修使用了易燃材料，整栋大楼在20分钟内陷入火海。

en.s: The 1980 Ispaster attack was a gun and grenade attack by the Basque separatist organisation ETA which occurred on 1 February 1980 near the Basque town of Ispaster. The targets were a convoy of civil guards who were escorting workers and weapons from the nearby Esperanza y Cia Arms factory to Bilbao. A total of six civil guards were killed, while two ETA members were killed by hand grenades that they had thrown.

zh.s: 1980年2月1日，巴斯克分离主义组织“埃塔”在伊斯帕斯特镇附近发动枪击和手榴弹袭击。目标是一支国民警卫队车队，当时正护送附近埃斯佩兰萨武器工厂的工人和武器前往毕尔巴鄂。共六名国民警卫队员死亡，两名埃塔成员也被自己投出的手榴弹炸死。

With one ball of the final over remaining in the match, New Zealand required a six to tie the match.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Finland in 1988. They were the first elections held under a new system. Previously, the public had elected an electoral college that in turn elected the President. For this election, the public directly elected the President on 31 January and 1 February, but also elected an electoral college that would elect the President if no candidate won over 50% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1988年芬兰举行总统选举，这是该国首次采用新的选举制度。此前，选民先选出选举人团，再由选举人团选举总统。这次选举中，选民于1月31日和2月1日直接投票选总统，同时也选出一个选举人团；如果没有候选人获得超过50%的普选票，该选举人团就负责选出总统。

en.s: The Battle of Khafji was the first major ground engagement of the Gulf War. It took place in and around the Saudi Arabian city of Khafji, from 29 January to 1 February 1991. Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein, who had already tried and failed to draw Coalition forces into costly ground engagements by shelling Saudi Arabian positions and oil storage tanks and firing Scud surface-to-surface missiles at Israel, ordered the invasion of Saudi Arabia from southern Kuwait.

zh.t: 海湾战争中的海夫吉战役
zh.s: 海夫吉战役是海湾战争中的首次重大地面交战，发生于1991年1月29日至2月1日，战场在沙特阿拉伯城市海夫吉及其周边。伊拉克领导人萨达姆·侯赛因此前曾试图通过炮击沙特阵地和石油储存罐、向以色列发射飞毛腿地对地导弹，引诱联军投入代价高昂的地面战，但未能得逞。随后，他下令伊拉克军队从科威特南部入侵沙特阿拉伯。

en.t: Earthquake strikes the Hindu Kush region

zh.t: 兴都库什地区发生强震
zh.s: 世界协调时1991年2月1日23时03分，阿富汗兴都库什山脉地下发生地震，阿富汗、巴基斯坦和今塔吉克斯坦部分地区遭到严重破坏。所引地震研究给出的矩震级为6.8级。

en.s: On the evening of Friday, February 1, 1991, USAir Flight 1493, a Boeing 737-300, collided with SkyWest Airlines Flight 5569, a Fairchild Swearingen Metroliner turboprop aircraft, upon landing at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX). As Flight 1493 was on final approach, the local controller was distracted, though air traffic was not heavy at LAX, by a series of abnormalities, including a misplaced flight progress strip and an aircraft that had inadvertently switched off the tower frequency.

zh.t: 1991年洛杉矶机场跑道相撞事故
zh.s: 1991年2月1日星期五晚，美国航空1493号航班的一架波音737-300客机在洛杉矶国际机场降落时，与一架天西航空5569号航班的费尔柴尔德—斯威林根“美特罗”涡桨飞机相撞。当时1493号航班正准备降落。尽管洛杉矶机场空中交通并不繁忙，当地空管员却被一连串异常情况分散注意力，其中包括飞行进程条放错位置，以及一架飞机意外切换离开塔台频率。

en.s: Operation Maslenica was a Croatian Army offensive launched in January 1993 to retake territory in northern Dalmatia and Lika from Krajina Serb forces, with the stated military objective of pushing the Serbs back from approaches to Zadar, Maslenica and Karlobag, allowing a secure land route between Dalmatia and northern Croatia to be opened. While an undoubted net Croatian tactical success, the operation was only a moderate strategic success, and was condemned by the UN Security Council.

zh.s: 马斯莱尼察行动是克罗地亚军队于1993年1月发起的攻势，目标是从克拉伊纳塞族部队手中收复达尔马提亚北部和利卡地区。行动的军事目标是将塞族部队赶离扎达尔、马斯莱尼察和卡尔洛巴格周边，并开辟一条连接达尔马提亚与克罗地亚北部的安全陆路。行动无疑取得了战术上的净胜利，但战略成果有限，并遭到联合国安理会谴责。

en.s: The Hemsworth by-election, 1996 was a parliamentary by-election held in England on 1 February 1996 for the House of Commons constituency of Hemsworth in West Yorkshire. The vacancy was caused by the death of Hemsworth's Member of Parliament (MP), Derek Enright of the Labour Party. Enright, a former Member of the European Parliament (MEP) for Leeds, had held the seat since a by-election in 1991. The result was a Labour hold. The election saw the first contest by the Socialist Labour Party, ahead of the party's official formation. Based in nearby Barnsley, the organisation just saved its deposit, with 5.4% of the vote.

zh.s: 英国下议院位于英格兰西约克郡的赫姆斯沃思选区，于1996年2月1日举行补选。工党议员德里克·恩赖特去世，议席因而出缺。他曾代表利兹担任欧洲议会议员，自1991年补选起担任赫姆斯沃思议员。工党在本次补选中保住议席。尚未正式成立的社会主义工党也首次参选。这个以附近巴恩斯利为基地的组织获得5.4%的选票，刚好保住选举保证金。

en.t: The Communications Decency Act is passed by the U.S. Congress
en.s: The Communications Decency Act of 1996 (CDA) was the United States Congress's first legislative attempt to regulate obscene and indecent material on the Internet. In the 1997 landmark case Reno v. ACLU, the United States Supreme Court unanimously overturned most of the statute due to its restrictions on freedom of speech under the First Amendment to the U.S. Constitution.

zh.t: 美国国会通过《通信规范法》

A former government minister, the deputy governor of Erbil Province and the city's police chief were among those killed at offices of northern Iraq's main political groups, the Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP) and the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK). It was held on 1 February 2020 between 2019 Ecuadorian Serie A champions Delfín and 2019 Copa Ecuador champions LDU Quito, being the third final in a row played between both sides after the final series of both the league and the cup.

en.s: The 2020 Supercopa Uruguaya was the third edition of the Supercopa Uruguaya, Uruguay's football super cup. It was held on 1 February 2020 between 2019 Torneo Intermedio winners Liverpool and 2019 Primera División champions Nacional. The match was played at Estadio Domingo Burgueño in Maldonado, being this the first time the match was played away from Estadio Centenario in Montevideo due to it undergoing remodeling works.

zh.s: 2020年乌拉圭超级杯是该赛事的第三届。比赛于2020年2月1日举行，由2019年中级锦标赛冠军利物浦对阵2019年甲级联赛冠军民族队。比赛在马尔多纳多的多明戈·布尔格尼奥体育场举行；由于蒙得维的亚世纪球场正在翻修，这是该赛事首次移至该球场以外的场地举行。

en.s: A coup d'état in Myanmar began on the morning of 1 February 2021, when democratically elected members of the country's ruling party, the National League for Democracy (NLD), were deposed by the Tatmadaw, Myanmar's military, which then vested power in a military junta. Acting President of Myanmar Myint Swe proclaimed a year-long state of emergency and declared power had been transferred to Commander-in-Chief of Defence Services Senior General Min Aung Hlaing.

en.t: 2021 President of the Chamber of Deputies of Brazil election
en.s: The 2021 President of the Chamber of Deputies of Brazil election took place on 1 February 2021, the day after the opening day of the 3rd Session of the 56th Legislature of the National Congress. Incumbent President Rodrigo Maia can't run for re-election due to term limits. Deputy Arthur Lira (PP-AL) won Baleia Rossi (MDB-SP) with 302 votes over 145 votes on Rossi and 56 other votes.

en.t: Vietnam v China PR (2022 FIFA World Cup qualification)
en.s: On February 1, 2022, Vietnam men's national team played against the China PR in the eighth match of the 2022 FIFA World Cup qualification – AFC third round at the Mỹ Đình National Stadium, Hanoi, Vietnam. In this match, Vietnam surprisingly won 3–1 right on their home field to make China no longer have a chance to qualify for the 2022 FIFA World Cup, with goals from Hồ Tấn Tài in the 9th minute, Nguyễn Tiến Linh in the 16th minute and Phan Văn Đức in the 76th minute.

zh.t: 2022年世界杯预选赛越南对中国

en.s: A coup d'état was attempted in Guinea-Bissau on 1 February 2022. A few hours later, president Umaro Sissoco Embaló declared the coup over, he said that "many" members of the security forces had been killed in a "failed attack against democracy".
